gold.taskTitle: Apply to Speak at a Local TEDx Event
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to submit a speaker application to a TEDx event in their local area.

questions.title: What specific topic or idea do you want to present?
questions.description: Understanding the core idea or message the user wants to deliver on stage.

questions.title: Which city or region are you targeting for this TEDx?
questions.description: Identifying the geographic location to find the right TEDx event.

questions.title: Have you identified a specific TEDx event to apply to?
questions.description: Determining whether the user already has a target event or needs to find one.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline you are working toward?
questions.description: Understanding any time constraints around the application submission.

questions.title: Have you ever applied or spoken at a TEDx event before?
questions.description: Gauging the user's prior experience to tailor the plan appropriately.

questions.title: Do you already have a speaker bio or past speaking materials?
questions.description: Assessing what application assets the user already has prepared.

questions.title: What is the main outcome you want from speaking at TEDx?
questions.description: Understanding the user's deeper goal, such as visibility, credibility, or spreading an idea.
